content: Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ Ɩbátɔ
Pentekoste Ɛkɛ, igyi Israelfɔ atɔ pɔpwɛ ɔnɔ́ ɔdakɛ́ ámʋ lɔfʋn a, ahógyipʋ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛba befia amʋ́ ofíakpa.
Ɔtsáwʋlɛ pɛ́ á, olú kʋá igyi fɛ́ afú kpɔnkpɔntɩ ilotsu ɔsʋ́sʋ́ bɔbʋlá wóyí ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ mʋ́tɔ́ ámʋ.
Ɩnʋ bowun tɔkʋá igyi fɛ́ ogya plɛnplɛn, ɩlɛlɩan ɔdandʋ. Ɩlɛdasáɩ́n dɩ́nká amʋ́tɔ́ okugyíɔkʋsʋ.
Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ lɔbʋlá okugyíɔkʋtɔ, ɩlɛha okugyíɔkʋ léfi asɩ ɔdɛ ɔblɩ́ɩ bámbá blɩ́.
Brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, Yudafɔá bʋtenyá Bulu ifú, bʋbʋ ndɩ́tɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́ baba bʋtsie Yerusalem.
Brɛ́á ɔdɔm anfɩ bonu okitikíti amʋ a, bɛsrɩ́ befia ɩnʋ. Amʋ́tɔ́ okugyíɔkʋ lónu mʋ wúlutɔ ɔblɩ́ɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔnɔ́ lobwie amʋ́.
Ɩlɔwa amʋ́ ifú, wá amʋ́ wánwan. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ bɛɛ, “Ahá ánfɩ bʋdɛtɔɩ́ á, megyí Galileafɔ sɔ́ɔ́n bʋgyi?
Mʋ́ nkálɩ ɩlɔbwɛ asa anɩdénuá bʋdɛ anɩtɔ okugyíɔkʋ wúlutɔ ɔblɩ́ɩ blɩ́?
Anɩtɔ akʋ atsú Partia, Media, Elam, Mesopotamia, Yudea, Kapadokia, Ponto, Asia,
Frigia, Pamfilia, Egyipte ɔmátɔ́ pʋ́ Libia awúlu ánɩ́ ɩbʋ mantáa Kirene wúlutɔ. Akʋ ɛ́ botsú Roma wúlutɔ,

bʋ́gyi Yudafɔ pʋ́ amʋ́á bʋmegyí Yudafɔ bawíé Yudafɔ Bulusúmtɔ́ aná fɛ́ɛ́ bʋbʋ anɩtɔ. Kretafɔ pʋ́ Arabifɔ ɛ́ bʋbʋ anɩtɔ. Támɛ anɩdénuá bʋdɛ Bulu atɔ kpɔnkpɔntɩ ánɩ́ alabwɛ́ blɩ́ anɩtɔ okugyíɔkʋ ɔblɩ́tɔ.”
Alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ asʋ́n ámʋ ilobwie amʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ámʋ sʋ bɔbwɛ yɔɔ, sí bʋdɛ amʋ́ aba fɩtɛ́ bɛɛ, “Ngya amansʋ ɛ́ nɩ́?”
Támɛ amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ bɔbwɛ ahógyipʋ amʋ ahinlá bɛɛ, “Ntá banu bʋ.”
Petro Asʋ́ntɔ́lɛ Súná Ahá Ámʋ
Ɩnʋ Petro mʋa mʋ aba dúɔkʋn ámʋ bɔkʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́. Mʋ́ʋ́ Petro lótsu ɔmɛ fʋ́á bláa ɔdɔm amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Apíó aba Yudafɔ pʋ́ mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́á mlɩbʋ Yerusalem, mlɩhɩɛ yaa asʋ, anlɛ asʋ́ntɔ́ suna mlɩ.
Mlɩmákɩ mlɩaa ahá ánfɩ babʋ́, tsúfɛ́ ɔyɩ́ mɔkʋ́kɛ. Brɛ́á dokwebá ladá nɩ́.
Mboún asʋ́n ánfɩ ɩlaba ndɛ ánfɩ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Yoel lɛ́blɩ́ yáɩ́ nɩ́. Ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: ‘Bulu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nkɛ tráhɛ amʋtɔ á,
nɔ́pʋ mɩ́ Ɔŋɛ́ wá anyánkpʋ́sa fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́.
Mlɩ abi yinhɛ́ pʋ́ mlɩ abi tsɩhɛ́ bɛ́blɩ́ asʋ́n ánɩ́ nɔ́pʋwá amʋ́ ɔnɔ́.
Mlɩ nyasubi bówun atɔ́.
Mlɩ ayin dɛhɛn bókun nkude.
Nkɛ ámʋtɔ á, nɔ́pʋ mɩ́ Ɔŋɛ́ wá mɩ́ asúmpʋ́
atsɩ mʋ́a ayin fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ bɛ́blɩ́ asʋ́n ánɩ́ nɔ́pʋwá amʋ́ ɔnɔ́.
Nɔ́bwɛ ofúla nwʋlʋ́táasʋ,
bwɛ́ osúna ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ.
Ogyá, obugya pʋ́ ogyási tuun bɛ́ba ɔyɩ́tɔ́.
Owí ɔbɛ́ta ɔpá.
Ɔtsra ɛ́ ɔbɛ́pɛ kɔɔ fɛ́ obugya,
asa anɩ Wíe numnyam ɛkɛ kpɔnkpɔntɩ ámʋ ɩbɔ́fʋn.
Ɩbɛ́ba ánɩ́ ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ okpólí anɩ Wíe a, ɔbɛ́ha mʋ obénya nkpa.” ’ ”

content: Petro lɔ́yɔ mʋ́sʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ apíó Israelfɔ, mlɩyaa asʋ amlɩnu asʋ́n ánfɩ. Bulu lɔ́bwɛ ofúla mʋ́a atɔ́ kpɔnkpɔntɩ pʋ́ osúna tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ tsʋn Yesu Nasaretyin amʋsʋ, pʋ́súná ánɩ́ mʋlɔ́wa mʋ. Mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ mlɩlówun mʋ́, tsúfɛ́ mlɩ ansɩ́sʋ́ ɩ́nɩ fɛ́ɛ́ lɛba.
Igyi tɔ́á Bulu yin yaɩ́ dodo, igyi mʋ apɛ́ ánɩ́ bɛ́lɛ Yesu há mlɩ. Mlɩlɛ́ha ahá ánɩ́ bʋtamagyi mblasʋ bɛda mʋ mántá oyikpalíhɛsʋ, mɔ́ mʋ.
Támɛ Bulu lɛ́lɛ mʋ lowu sɩ́nsɩ́ɩ́nsɩ́ntɔ́, kʋ́sʋ́a mʋ tsú afúlitɔ. Tsúfɛ́ lowu mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ gyi mʋsʋ, osin afúlitɔ.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ́ Owíe Dawid lɛ́blɩ́ mʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: ‘Brégyíbrɛ́ á, ntowun anɩ Wíe mɩ́ ansɩ́sʋ́.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔlɩɩ́ mɩ́ gyɔpɩsʋ, sʋ tɔtɔ mɔ́ɔwa mɩ́ ifú.
Mʋ́ sʋ ansɩ́ tegyi mɩ,
ntɔtɔ́ɩ́ ansigyísʋ́.
Nyankpʋsa ngyi. Lowu da gyo mɩ́,
támɛ ndɛ Bulu ɔkpa kɩ́ɩ.
Tsúfɛ́ fʋméesi mɩ́ ɔkláa wá afúlitɔ.
Fʋmɛ́ɛha mɩ́ fʋ́ osúmpʋ́ wankɩ́hɛ́ mmɔ́ɔplɔ́.
Fʋ́lósuná mɩ́ ɔkpa ánɩ́ ntsʋ́ʋn mʋ́sʋ́, mɩ́ anya nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá.
Nɩ́ fʋ́bʋ mɩ́ wá á, ansɩ́ bégyi mɩ ekekegyíɛkɛ.’ ”

content: Petro lɛ́trá bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ apíó Israelfɔ, mbʋ́a hɩɛ bla mlɩ amlɩnu. Anɩ náin Owíe Dawid lówu, bopulá mʋ. Bɔ́tʋ ndɛ mʋ ntsán da anɩ wá nfɩ.
Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ ogyi, oyin ánɩ́ ntam ánɩ́ Bulu lɛ́ka há mʋ bɛ́ba mʋ́tɔ́. Bulu lɛ́ka ntam há mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, mɛ́ha mʋ natɩna ɔkʋ obétsiá mʋ obíásʋ́ ɛkɛ kʋ́.
Ɩ́nɩá anɩ náin Owíe Dawid lówun mʋ́ yáɩ́ sʋ á, ɔlɔtɔɩ́ tsú Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ) kʋsʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ ɩwɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: ‘Bulu méesi mʋ wá afúlitɔ.
Mʋ́ sʋ mʋ ɔyʋlʋ́ʋ mɔ́ɔplɔ́.’ ”

content: Petro lɔ́yɔ mʋ́sʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Yesu gyí ɔhá ánɩ́ Bulu lɔ́kʋsʋ́a tsu afúlitɔ, anɩ fɛ́ɛ́ anɩgyí mʋ́ adansɩfɔ.

Bulu lótsu Yesu ya ɔsʋ́sʋ́, há mʋ otsiákpá yilé mʋ gyɔpɩsʋ. Anɩ Sɩ́ Bulu lɔ́pʋ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ ánɩ́ ɔlɛhɩɛ yáɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, mɔ́pʋhá mʋ ahógyipʋ há mʋ. Ɔŋɛ́ ámʋ Yesu lapʋ́há anɩ á. Mʋ́ gyumagyihɛ mlɩdéwúun, mlɩdénu á.
Megyí Owíe Dawid Bulu lótsu ya ɔsʋ́sʋ́, támɛ mʋlɛ́blɩ́ yáɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: ‘Anɩ Wíe Bulu lɛ́bláa mɩ́ Wíe ɔbɛ́ɛ,
Tsia mɩ́ gyɔpɩsʋ,
yɔ́fʋn brɛ́á nɔ́pʋ fʋ́ alupʋ́ bwɛ́ fʋ́ ayabi oyíkpa.’ ”

content: “Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩ Israelfɔ fɛ́ɛ́ mlɩnu. Ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́á mlɩlɛ́da Yesu mántá oyikpalíhɛsʋ. Támɛ mlɩhɩɛ bɩ ánɩ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli, bwɛ́ mʋ Kristo pʋ́ anɩ Wíe.”
Brɛ́á Israelfɔ ámʋ bonu asʋ́n ánfɩ á, ɩlɛhɩɛ han amʋ́. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ Petro mʋa mʋ aba sumbí ayɔpʋ́ atráhɛ amʋ bɛɛ, “Apíó, ntɔ abwɛ́ɛ?”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Petro lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩtɔ okugyíɔkʋ ɔdámli klʋntɔ, abɔ mlɩ asú Yesu Kristo dátɔ́, mɛ́nɩ Bulu obési mlɩ lakpan kíé mlɩ, há mlɩ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ.
Tsúfɛ́ mlɩa mlɩ abí-aná pʋ́ ahá ánɩ́ bʋbʋ tsútsúútsú ánɩ́ Bulu ɔbɛ́tɩ fɛ́ɛ́ ɔlɛhɩɛ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ anfɩ há.”
Petro lɛ́blɩ́ asʋ́n tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ, pʋ́tɔ́ɩ́ kplá amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩlɛ mlɩ ɩwɩ tsu ndɛmba-abí laláhɛ anfɩtɔ.”
Amʋ́tɔ́ ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bɔhɔ Petro asʋ́n ámʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ bɔbɔ amʋ́ asú. Ɛkɛ ámʋ a, ahá bɔ́bwɛ fɛ́ mpɩ́m-sa (3,000) bɛtsɩá ahógyipʋ amʋtɔ.
Ahógyipʋ amʋ bɛlɛ ansɩ́ kɩ́tá sumbí ayɔpʋ́ ámʋ atosunáhɛ́, amʋ́ ɩkʋlɛbwɛ tógyítɔ́tɔ́, ɔpasua ámʋtɔ atogyihɛtɔ yée pʋ́ mpáɩbɔtɔ́.
Ahógyipʋ Amʋ Tsiátɔ́
Sumbí ayɔpʋ́ ámʋ bɔbwɛ ofúla pʋ́ osúna tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ, ɔnɔ́ lobwie ɔhagyíɔha.
Ahógyipʋ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɔbwɛ tógyítɔ́ kʋlɛ. Betsiá ye amʋ́ atɔ́ há aba.
Betsiá fɛ́ amʋ́ atɔ́, ye kɔ́ba ánɩ́ benyatɔ há amʋ́tɔ́ okugyíɔkʋá ɔma.
Amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ betsiá fía Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ekekegyíɛkɛ. Bɔpʋ amʋ́ klʋntɔ-ɔdwɛ tsíá gyi atɔ́ ɔpasuatɔ amʋ́ aba wóyítɔ́.
Betsiá kánfʋ́ Bulu, ahá fɛ́ɛ́ bekle amʋ́ asʋ́n, anɩ Wíe Bulu létsiá pʋ́ ahá ánɩ́ ɔdɛlɛ bɛtsɩá amʋ́tɔ́ ekekegyíɛkɛ.
